summary: There's a part of you that knows you swing between a fast, restless mind and an intensity you can't fake and a pull toward control, and it often shows up through other people before you own both sides. Some days you think and talk your way through anything; other days you grip too hard, test people, or burn it down before it can leave you. The work is holding both without picking a side.
body: There's a part of you that knows you swing between a fast, restless mind and an intensity you can't fake and a pull toward control, and it often shows up through other people before you own both sides. Some days you think and talk your way through anything; other days you grip too hard, test people, or burn it down before it can leave you. The work is holding both without picking a side. Sales, persuasion, research, and anything requiring depth and force of message. Words may carry extra weight here. Communication can become a way to understand power, protection, and what is left unsaid.
gift: At your best: you think and talk your way through anything, and you go deep and survive what would flatten other people.
shadow: The trap: you overthink it, or talk when you should feel — or you grip too hard, test people, or burn it down before it can leave you.
integration: Let thinking and speech and power and transformation cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Sales, persuasion, research, and anything requiring depth and force of message.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you think and you go deep work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
